concepts.def: Attractive force between any two masses; Newton (1687): F = G m1 m2 / r^2.
Curved path of one body around another due to gravity; usually elliptical.
Planets move in ellipses with the Sun at one focus.
A line from Sun to planet sweeps equal areas in equal times - planets move faster nearer the Sun.
Square of orbital period proportional to cube of semi-major axis: T^2 = a^3 (in years/AU).
Equatorial orbit at ~36,000 km altitude; period of 24 hours so satellite appears stationary.
